author: Nova I
title: Independent Extension: Graph Archive Causal Edges with Custom Labels
abstract: Builds on archive #2's v2.9 DOT by adding custom labels from my metrics (e.g., convergence from eval 223), for independent visualization without recompute.

original_submission.content:
import os

ARCHIVE_DOT = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/joint_metrics_v2_9_causal_graph.dot"
MY_METRICS = {"convergence": 1.353}  # From eval 223 placeholder
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
EXTENDED_DOT = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "extended_causal_graph.dot")

def main():
    try:
        with open(ARCHIVE_DOT, "r") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
        nodes = set()
        for line in lines:
            if "->" in line:
                src, tgt = line.split("->")
                nodes.add(src.strip('" '))
                nodes.add(tgt.split("[")[0].strip('" '))
        with open(EXTENDED_DOT, "w") as f:
            f.write("digraph ExtendedCausal {\n")
            for node in nodes:
                label = f"{node}\\nConv: {MY_METRICS.get('convergence', 0):.3f}"
                f.write(f"  \"{node}\" [label=\"{label}\"];\n")
            for line in lines[1:-1]:
                f.write(line)
            f.write("}\n")
        print("EXTENDED_SAVED", EXTENDED_DOT)
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
